notes.observed_gap: EXPLORING treats persistent dungeons/leave.png passive anchor matches as handled work, resets local no-match accounting, returns without gameplay progress, and eventually reaches the outer watchdog timeout
notes.confirmed_root_cause: two-layer defect: passive dungeon-presence evidence is conflated with actionable progress, and confirmed in-dungeon actionless exploration has no bounded local stall handoff
notes.authoritative_owner: ExploreHandler owns dungeon-local action selection and local stall classification; global watchdog remains disaster recovery only
notes.required_solution_shape: Option B: give leave.png non-consuming passive semantics and add bounded handling for EXPLORING + confirmed dungeon presence + no actionable event after existing legal transition windows expire
notes.existing_test_conflict: tests.test_dungeon_relaunch_recovery::test_3_explore_handler_handles_leave_anchor currently requires no_explore_match_count to reset on leave.png and must be corrected while preserving the no-click invariant
notes.implementation_constraint: do not invent destructive leave-click recovery, fake notify_ui_progress heartbeats, background watchdogs, or global exception redesign
